precepts.text: It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed.
precepts.point: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers. Our help is in the name of the Lord.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
King David says, “If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say”: the Lord was on Israel’s side, “when men rose up against us”, when the nations rose up against us. Think about that. The only reason we are still breathing is the mercy of the Lord.

Lamentations says it plainly: “It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.” That we, brothers and sisters, are still here is only because of the Lord. With the weapons Esau has and the weapons the nations have, if the Lord put the spirit on them to do what they do and gave them free reign with us, we would all have been wiped out.

Read on: “They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.” “The Lord is my portion, saith my soul”. His compassion does not fail, and that is why Psalms 124 can say the nations did not swallow us up.

precepts.text: The Lord is longsuffering and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity, and by no means clearing the guilty.
precepts.point: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers. Our help is in the name of the Lord.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
“The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression”. Being longsuffering is one of the characteristics we must take on with our brothers and our sisters. A lot of times we are carnal and have no patience with each other. A brother offends you, or does what you think is an offence that he may not even see as one, and you get all in your feelings; sisters get in their feelings about something somebody said or the way somebody moves toward them. We are all different spirits joining together for one common goal. We are not all going to get along, but we all have to be longsuffering with each other and endure it.

Then: “and by no means clearing the guilty”. Why is he of great mercy but will by no means clear the guilty? Just because you sin and are not judged immediately does not mean you will not be judged; you are still guilty of that sin. And to get that great mercy, you have to repent and forsake your sins. The ones he will not clear are those that do not repent, and he visits “the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.”

So back to Psalms 124: it is of the Lord’s mercy, longsuffering with Israel, that the men who rose up against us did not swallow us up.

precepts.text: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters, but God shall rebuke them.
precepts.point: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers. Our help is in the name of the Lord.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
Psalms 124 goes on: “Then they had swallowed us up quick”, the nations would have swallowed us up, “Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:” “Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.” The waters are not the water of affliction. Write it down, brothers: the waters in Psalms 124 are the nations.

Isaiah proves it: “Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!” Keep reading: “The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters”. He is comparing the nations to waters.

“but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.” That is the Lord being on our side: the proud waters, the nations, rush against Israel, and God rebukes them.

precepts.text: The waters where the whore sitteth are peoples, and multitudes, and nations.
precepts.point: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers. Our help is in the name of the Lord.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
One more precept on the waters: “The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” The waters are peoples and nations again, and the one sitting on them is America. Look at where America sits: bases and fleets all over the earth.

So what could Russia do with this? America does not have to send its entire fleet to Russia or to China; it is already there, it does not have to go anywhere. If I was Trump, I might boast too. Look at the weaponry he has.

That is the power of the nations the Psalm is talking about. “Then the proud waters had gone over our soul”, but “Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.” Because of the Lord’s mercies, “Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.” And “Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth”: that name is God’s commandments with faith in his Son.

moments.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

points: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say. The Lord had to be on our side.
If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men rose up against us. When Edom rose up against us, with their perpetual hatred for us.

Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us. He would have swallowed us up quickly. He would have destroyed us off the face of the earth. That is why the Lord had to get involved. All those things listed, the Lord had to get involved for this man not to wipe us off the face of the earth.
If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, then they had swallowed us up quick. The nations are the waters that would have gone over our soul.
Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers. Our help is in the name of the Lord.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

points: If it had not been for the Most High who was on our side, now may Israel say, if it had not been for the Most High who was on our side when men rose up against us, then they had swallowed us up quick when their wrath was kindled against us.

When Christians go to say that these psalms are not talking about Israel, these psalms are talking about Israel being saved from their enemies, being protected from our enemies, because our help only comes from the Most High God of Israel.

note.label: Psalm 124: If the Most High Had Not Been on Our Side

points: When the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul, then the proud waters had gone over our soul. Blessed be the Most High, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

note.label: Psalm 124: If the Most High Had Not Been on Our Side

points: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers, and the snare is broken and we are escaped. Our help is in the name of the Most High, who made heaven and earth.
